additions.description: Rounds all floating point nutritional values to two decimal places in responses

omissions.description: GET /profiles request is only allowed by the restaurant Owner, but the code allows any authenticated user to perform GET /profiles
omissions.reasoning: The specification states 'The GET /profiles request is only allowed by the restaurant Owner' but the code does not check for privileged user status before allowing GET /profiles.

omissions.reasoning: The specification states these requests are only allowed by the user of that id, implying no other user (including Owner) can access them. The code enforces this correctly, so no omission here.
